In addition to the aforementioned koosevelt School situation, an involvement with Cook County Forest Preserve District lands became evident during the preparation of the Final Environmental Statement.
We are in the process of preparing a Section 4(f) Statement for the above captioned project concerning a temporary construction easement on Cook County Forest Preserve District land. In order to document early coordination and idenify probable environmental impacts and effects to the proposed temporary use of Cook County Forest Preserve District land, I have attached descriptive material and exhibits for your review and comment in relation to your special knowledge and expertise.
Your earliest consideration and review of the material is greatly appreciated. If you have any questions, please contact Mr. Richard L. Garrity at (312) 793-2276.
Very truly yours,
Sigmund C. Ziejewski District Engineer
By: Henry M. Yamanaka
Mobility Studies Engineer
